design_detail: 1% annual tax on wealth above HUF 5bn (first Tisza pledge; later set at HUF 1bn)
quote_original: Az 5 milliárd forint feletti vagyonokra a TISZA-kormány bevezeti a vagyonadót
quote_en: On wealth above HUF 5 billion the TISZA government will introduce a wealth tax
source_title: Magyar Péter vagyonadót vezetne be az ötmilliárd forint feletti vagyonokra
grading_note: Party leader's Facebook post as reported by 444.hu: names the tax, the threshold and the pledge that a Tisza government will introduce it.

design_detail: 1% a year on wealth above HUF 1bn, covering company shares and luxury property
quote_original: Bevezetjük az évi 1 százalékos vagyonadót az egymilliárd forintnál magasabb vagyonokra.
quote_en: We will introduce a 1 per cent annual wealth tax on wealth above one billion forints.
source_title: Nyugdíjemelés, vagyonadó, euró – ezt ígéri a Tisza adópolitikai szakértője
grading_note: Programme pledge with rate and threshold, given by the party's tax-policy expert (Index quotes his Népszava interview); it became government policy after the April 2026 election.

design_detail: Tisza proposal: 1% on wealth above HUF 1bn ("proportionate at first glance")
quote_original: Egyetértek azzal az elvvel, hogy akinek nagyobb vagyona van, nagyobb arányban járuljon hozzá a közterhekhez.
quote_en: I agree with the principle that whoever has more wealth should contribute a larger share to public burdens.
source_title: Az egyik leggazdagabb magyar, Jellinek Dániel szerint jó a Tisza gazdaságpolitikájának iránya
grading_note: His own written reply as quoted by 444: agrees with the principle and finds the 1% rate and HUF 1bn threshold proportionate at first glance, while warning that detail rules matter; hedged, so grade B. Replaces the trade-press summary of round 1.

source_title: Bojár Gábor: Azok közé tartozom, akiknek drága lesz a vagyonadó, de azt mondom, hogy jogos
grading_note: Interview headline in his own words; names the tax and accepts it for himself; the interview was about the Tisza proposal (see also Telex 16 Apr 2026). The rate and threshold come from the question, so grade B.
